name: M7.Selection.pareto_laws
statement: ∀ (m : ℕ), (∀ a : Fin m → ℤ, ¬ M7.Selection.pareto a a) ∧ (∀ a b c : Fin m → ℤ, M7.Selection.pareto a b → M7.Selection.pareto b c → M7.Selection.pareto a c)
guidance: Unfold pareto. Irreflexivity follows from the required strict coordinate. For transitivity combine coordinatewise inequalities and reuse a strict coordinate from the first relation with the second weak inequality. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact statement and default limits.
